title: vernalization
intro: Requirement for a cold period before flowering.

sections.name: default
sections.used: crop Rye Vernal (see 29.29, page 176) , crop Winter Barley Vernal (see 29.40, page 177) , crop Winter Barley; Koge Vernal (see 29.42, page 177) , crop Winter Rape Vernal (see 29.43, page 177) , crop Winter Wheat Vernal (see 29.44, page 177) , crop Grass to grain Vernal (see 29.10, page 174) , crop Ryegrass Vernal (see 29.30, page 176) , and crop Wclover Vernal (see 29.36, page 176) .
sections.text:
Temperature sum dependent vernalization.
    Used by crop Rye Vernal (see 29.29, page 176) , crop Winter Barley Vernal (see
29.40, page 177) , crop Winter Barley; Koge Vernal (see 29.42, page 177) , crop
Winter Rape Vernal (see 29.43, page 177) , crop Winter Wheat Vernal (see 29.44,
page 177) , crop Grass to grain Vernal (see 29.10, page 174) , crop Ryegrass Vernal
(see 29.30, page 176) , and crop Wclover Vernal (see 29.36, page 176) .
   < default (DSLim DSLim )
                 (TaLim TaLim )
                 (TaSum TaSum ) >

    DSLim: number [DS]
     Parameter
     Development stage at vernalization.
    TaLim: number [dg C]
     Parameter
     Vernalization temperature threshold.
    TaSum: number [dg C d]
     State variable
     Vernalization temperature-sum requirement.

sections.name: none
sections.text:
No vernalization.
   Used by crop default Vernal (see 29.1, page 171) .
